description: Update a page's default or active status for a connected account. Set is_default=true to make this the default page for publishing and inbox operations. Set is_active=false to deactivate a page (it will no longer receive events or appear in default listings). Idempotent -- setting the current value has no effect. Use social_api_list_account_pages to find the page_id first.
name: social_api_update_account_page
title: Update Account Page
